obs = observe()
blue_book = obs["objects"]["blue_book"]
orange_tray = obs["zones"]["orange_tray"]

candidates = grasp_candidates("blue_book")
# Choose candidate with fingers along long axis (yaw ≈ object_long_axis_yaw)

carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["gripper_yaw"])
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()

check("blue_book", "orange_tray")
